title: PR #105: docs: align ecosystem SSOT and verification claims
content:
State: closed
Merged: True

## Summary
- Clarify that this repository is an integration/evidence control plane, not the canonical implementation owner for all components.
- Correct the canonical ShivaCore kernel source to `globus-os/modules/atc-shivacore/kernel/`.
- Reclassify the end-to-end runtime path as an integration contract until every edge has exact-SHA evidence, rather than claiming the whole path is already verified.
- Replace unsupported whole-system verification wording and stale numbered-PR roadmap instructions with current evidence/reconciliation work.

## Evidence discipline
- Documentation-only change.
- No status is upgraded to VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_READY.
- No CI/release gate is weakened.
- Review against the canonical source repositories and exact-SHA evidence before merge.
